project_text:
A full-stack personal website built with Python and the NiceGUI framework.

Deployed on a VPS with CI/CD automation via GitHub Actions and Nginx reverse proxy configuration.

A social media platform concept for sharing Sparklets between friends.

Built with a Vue frontend and FastAPI backend, with MongoDB integration secured through a private Tailscale network.

An open-source hardware and software solution for remote machine administration with KVM functionality.

Features a Vue single-page application that provides video capture and keyboard/mouse control for managing local servers remotely.

A developer productivity tool that automates repetitive coding tasks for tutorial creation.

Built as a Python multiprocess application using MQTT protocol for inter-process communication and real-time task coordination.

A local web service that creates short, memorable aliases for frequently accessed IP addresses and web URLs.

Simplifies network navigation for developers and system administrators working with multiple local services.

A productivity utility that provides quick access to special characters on US keyboard layouts through a hotkey-activated interface.

Offers automatic insertion and clipboard copying of commonly needed special characters for multilingual content and technical documentation.
